text:
deploy-bot: starting a short deploy window for autocomplete-service. image = autocomplete:2026-06-20-0100. feature flag `autocomplete_v4` going to 1% -> 10% taper. quiet window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Posting checkpoints.

tara: ack. plan: 1% (10m) -> 5% (15m) -> 10% (20m). Hold at each step for telemetry. thresholds: p95>250ms OR 5xx>0.4% => drain.

ben: pin canary image for the run (autocomplete:2026-06-20-0100). added note in release ticket. keep cohort sticky 20m.

infra-oncall: oncall here. nodepool capacity checked, we have headroom. if paging needed, call me.

deploy-bot: ff commands:
```
/ff set autocomplete_v4 --percent 1 --cohort canary
/ff set autocomplete_v4 --percent 5
/ff set autocomplete_v4 --percent 10
/ff set autocomplete_v4 --percent 0   # emergency drain
```

telemetry: temp dashboard created with metrics: `auto.latency.p95`, `auto.5xx_rate`, `auto.relevance.delta`. Alert: p95>250ms OR 5xx>0.4% for 5m => page.

tara: canary applied. will report at +10m.

deploy-bot: 10m checkpoint: p95=130ms, 5xx=0.05% :thumbsup: ramping to 5% in 1m.

ben: bumping node autoscaler min by +2 for canary group.

telemetry: 15m checkpoint @5%: p95=145ms, 5xx=0.07%, relevance delta -0.2% -> proceeding to 10%.

infra-oncall: readiness confirmed.

deploy-bot: final ramp to 10% complete. soak 20m. will post final.

telemetry: 20m final: p95=150ms, 5xx=0.1%, relevance delta -0.3% -> within thresholds. no rollout issues.

release-eng: added canary observations to release notes: pinned image + rollout percentages and telemetry summary. will add troubleshooting steps.

tara: small follow-up: keep the temporary dashboard for 24h and then archive. thanks team.

deploy-bot: window closed. summary posted to ticket.
